name: brewlint-extension
description: Spring Boot anti-patterns as you type: private @Transactional methods, unclosed resources, field injection, and more, as Diagnostics.

brewlint.enabled.description: Analyse the project and report findings as Diagnostics.

brewlint.debounce.description: Milliseconds to wait after a save before rescanning. A rescan of a large project is not instant, and 0 turns every save into a full analysis.

brewlint.scanTimeout.description: Milliseconds before a scan is abandoned. The project-level message says so rather than leaving the Problems panel stale with no explanation.

brewlint.binaryPath.description: Absolute path to a Brewlint binary to use instead of the bundled one. Leave empty unless you are testing a build. The bundle needs no Java and is the supported path.
